RECOMMENDED UNCONDITIONAL BEST AND FINAL cash offer
for
HARWORTH GROUP PLC ("Harworth")
by
PEEL PEPPER (UK) Limited ("BidCo"), A COMPANY INDIRECTLY WHOLLY-OWNED BY PEEL HOLDINGS GROUP LIMITED
CLOSING OF BEST AND FINAL OFFER
Introduction

On 25 September 2026, BidCo and Harworth jointly announced the terms of an increased, recommended, best and final cash offer for Harworth at a price of 187 pence per Harworth Share (the "Best and Final Offer").

Capitalised terms used in this announcement, unless otherwise defined, have the same meanings as set out in the offer document setting out the full terms of the Best and Final Offer published on 2 October 2026.
Best and Final Offer closed
The Best and Final Offer closed for acceptances at 1.00 p.m. on 10 November 2026 and is no longer capable of being accepted.
Compulsory acquisition

As announced on 26 October 2026, BidCo has begun the implementation of the compulsory acquisition procedure to acquire the remaining ordinary shares to which the Best and Final Offer relates under Chapter 3 of Part 28 of the Companies Act.

On 26 October 2026, BidCo despatched formal compulsory acquisition notices under sections 979 and 980 of the Companies Act (the "Compulsory Acquisition Notices") to Harworth Shareholders who had not yet validly accepted the Best and Final Offer (the "Non-Assenting Shareholders"). The Compulsory Acquisition Notices stated that BidCo intends to compulsorily acquire the remaining Harworth Shares to which the Best and Final Offer relates.

As detailed in the Compulsory Acquisition Notices and subject to the provisions of the Companies Act, on the expiry of six weeks from the date of those notices the remaining Non-Assenting Shareholders will have their Harworth Shares registered in BidCo's name and the consideration payable to each such remaining shareholder will be held on trust by Harworth under section 981(9) of the Companies Act.
Cancellation and re-registration

As announced by Harworth on 14 October 2026, the cancellation of the listing of the Harworth Shares on the Official List and of their admission to trading on the Main Market of the London Stock Exchange is expected to take effect at 8.00 a.m. on 12 November 2026. Transfers of Harworth Shares will not be registered after 6.00 p.m. on 11 November 2026.

Following the cancellation of listing and admission to trading of the Harworth Shares and completion of the compulsory acquisition of the Harworth Shares held by the Non-Assenting Shareholders pursuant to the Compulsory Acquisition Notices, it is intended that Harworth will be re-registered as a private limited company.

Publication on website

In accordance with Rule 26.1 of the Takeover Code, a copy of this announcement will be available on the website of BidCo at www.peel.co.uk/investor-notice/details promptly and by no later than 12 noon (London time) on the business day following this announcement. The contents of the website referred to in this announcement are not incorporated into and do not form part of this announcement.
Requesting hard copy documents

Pursuant to Rule 30.3 of the Takeover Code, a person so entitled may request a copy of this announcement in hard copy form by contacting the Company Secretarial Department on companysecretarial@peel.co.uk. A person may also request that all future documents, announcements and information to be sent to that person in relation to the Best and Final Offer should be in hard copy form. For persons who receive a copy of this announcement in electronic form or via a website notification, a hard copy of this announcement will not be sent unless so requested.
